messages:
Claire (product): Quick sync: several enterprise pilots said we need an "evidence export" acceptance checklist before Dedicated. Key asks: tamper-evident exports, long-tail retention policy, BYOK/rotation + escrow options, and a legal-hold workflow. Can we agree an MVP checklist?
Dev (eng-runtime): My short list for MVP: 1) signed manifest with per-file sha256 and signer_id/key_version, 2) export delivery receipt (signed), 3) retention lanes (hot/warm/cold) with opt-in billing, 4) legal-hold that blocks purge.
Mohan (security): Add: support tenant-provided public keys OR tenant-managed KMS AsymmetricSign. For long-term verification after rotation, include `signer_key_version` + timestamp. Also propose a signed revocation log: when a key is revoked we publish a signed revocation entry so tenants can detect old exports signed by revoked keys.
Lena (ops): Operational constraints: we can't index 7y for everyone. Proposed lanes: Hot(90d indexed, <5s), Warm(2y, <30s), Cold(7y archive, searchable within 24-72h). Exports queued; default SLA for pilot: small (<10GB) within 24h, large best-effort. We'll add a "rush" paid lane. Legal-hold toggles should mark objects immutable in storage layer.
Claire (product): For escrow: pilots want options: (A) tenant-managed KMS (recommended), (B) tenant uploads public keys (we keep history), (C) third-party escrow with signed handoff. We should capture these in PRD and offer recommended default.
Dev (eng-runtime): Mini-manifest example (MVP):
```json
{"format":"tar.gz","files":[{"path":"audit/2026-03.log","sha256":"..."}],"signer":"projects/redwood-kms/keys/tenant-sign/versions/2","signature":"BASE64...","timestamp":"2026-03-23T12:34:56Z"}
```
We'll avoid Merkle trees in MVP to keep scope small.
Mohan (security): Verification UX: Console should let customers upload archived public keys and run a verification check that does: 1) verify signature+key_version, 2) compare per-file sha256, 3) check revocation log and timestamp. I'll draft revocation & rotation policy.
Lena (ops): Cost note for PRD: hot index ~ $0.025/GB/mo, warm ~ $0.008/GB/mo, cold archive ~ $0.001/GB/mo. Also include egress/CPU export fees. Runbook: request -> auth check -> enqueue -> snapshot -> sign -> stage -> generate signed receipt -> notify tenant.
contracts-bot: Legal: agree on SLA appendix and a 30-day evidence delivery warranty for pilot. Also want a clause for legal-hold overrides and redaction requests. Tagging @legal for template.
Claire (product): Prioritization suggestion: MUST for pilot = signed manifest + signed receipt + retention lanes + legal-hold + rotation metadata. SHOULD = revocation log, escrow UI, DLP/redaction flow.
Dev (eng-runtime): Estimates: 2 sprints for signing+manifest+export plumbing, 1 sprint for retention gates and legal-hold, 1 sprint for Console verification UI.
Mohan (security): I'll post rotation/escrow policy & threat model this week.
Lena (ops): I'll produce cost appendix and ops constraints.
Claire (product): Action items: Dev -> prototype manifest + small CLI example; Mohan -> rotation/revocation doc; Lena -> cost+runbook; legal -> SLA text. I'll draft PRD and schedule 30m sync. Thanks :thumbsup:
